home.scoutHeadline: Kraken Runs the Challenge. Scout Beats It.

home.scoutDisclosure: Kraken-owned: Kraken Funded publishes the challenge, every threshold and the tiers, and the funded account is provided by Payward Oceanic Ltd. (BVI); Kraken acts as the platform interface. Pool-owned: Kraken Scout is our engineered answer to it.
